title: Ciyou Temple
geometryBasis: Official building identity, mapped precinct perimeter, and the exact published daytime temple photograph establish the shell. The Ministry of the Interior identifies the axial progression of halls.
sectionBasis: The cleared Qualla view and temple records establish five entry bays, three successive halls, triple main eaves, paired bell and drum pavilions, bright golden-orange tiles and ceramic ridge figures.
limitations: The connected temple exterior and visible entrance steps. The surrounding market, railway access and interior devotional objects lie outside scope.
Hidden roof connections and individual ridge sculpture details are estimated from the cleared front views and government description.
